name.description: Project folder name this preset applies to (case-insensitive).

extraTabs.description: Additional shell tabs opened in other folders.

launch.description: Extra applications started with the project.

startupCommand.description: Runs in this project's shell tab when it launches (e.g. npm run dev), instead of the git status summary. No double quotes.

urls.description: Addresses (http/https) opened in the default browser each time this project is launched.

claudeArgs.description: Replaces config.json claudeArgs for this project (no double quotes).

shell.description: Override config.json shell for this project.

diff.description: Override config.json diff for this project.

tabColor.description: Fixed tab color instead of the name hash.
